rows.description: A young adult chases a target set by family or friends and feels empty on reaching it; goals that do not match personal values yield little satisfaction even when achieved.

rows.subtype: Linking the goal to the next step [Response]
rows.description: An adult sets one big aim, splits it into monthly and weekly actions, and reviews it kindly every week; flexible plans survive real life better than rigid ones.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child who fears being wrong will only do puzzles they already know how to solve; avoiding failure feels safe but also blocks learning.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, confusion, trust

rows.description: A teenager who lost a debate feels their worth has dropped and avoids the next contest; fear is about what failing says about them and not about the task.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A student picks the easy course to protect a high grade point average and never tries the field they love; fear of falling short quietly makes the choices.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
related mind states: affection, fear, trust

rows.description: An adult who failed a business attempt writes what they learned, tells a few trusted people, and applies it to the next one; failure becomes data rather than a verdict.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child changes answers to whatever seems to please the teacher and looks anxiously at faces for a sign; approval is a strong reward but can crowd out honest thought.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager agrees with friends against their own view and laughs at jokes they dislike; fear of rejection makes the group's approval more important than the self.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young adult from a close family seeks parental praise for every decision and feels guilty when their wish differs; love and duty pull against a still-forming self.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A team member notices a colleague who agrees to every request and burns out quietly; the observer offers backup so the colleague can practise saying no without losing standing.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
